svg.title: The Bible as a library of 66 books | 圣经是一座 66 卷书的图书馆
svg.desc: Two shelves hold 39 Old Testament books and 27 New Testament books. Each spine shows the book's Chinese abbreviation; its width grows with the number of chapters, and its color shows the book's section. | 两层书架摆放旧约 39 卷与新约 27 卷。书脊上写着中文缩写，宽度随章数增加，颜色表示所属分类。
